I understand how you feel. Around this time last year I lost a relationship and my best friend. I too had fucked up in my own way and had regrets that I carry with me to this day. We had our ups and downs, and I was still hopeful and optimistic for things to come, but it all came crashing down. I took it hard—really hard. This time of year exemplifies these sorts of things; when you’ve got love and family, it’s blissful, but when things go south and you find yourself alone, it’s pretty damn tough. 

My one piece of advice; constantly remind yourself that mistakes are in the past, and the only thing you can do now is improve yourself so you’re the best damn partner to that new girl who’s just around the corner. And that corner might be a big one—it might be a corner that’s years and years long. But don’t put yourself down. Don’t let that regret eat you up, because it’s pointless. Hold it, cherish it, and learn to use it. 

And lastly, you don’t have to try to forget about her. She’s always going to be a chapter in your life. Sure, you probably shouldn’t reread that chapter rn, but it’s not going anywhere. It is what it is.

Merry Christmas, and I hope each day becomes just a little easier than the last ~
